actions.description: Publish one flat five-block std_msgs/Float64MultiArray motor frame on the Gazebo effort-controller command topic. The receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, never that the controller received it, that a joint moved or that the robot stopped.

inputs.description: Flat Float64MultiArray data frame: indices 0-11 desired positions in rad, 12-23 kp in N.m/rad, 24-35 desired velocities in rad/s, 36-47 kd in N.m.s/rad and 48-59 feed-forward torques in N.m; the order is the twelve joints of controllers.yaml
inputs.name: data

actions.name: publish_joint_pd_frame

outputs.description: True when the driver handed the publication to rosbridge
outputs.name: published

outputs.description: Always false: a rosbridge publication carries no execution or stopping confirmation
outputs.name: confirmed

facts.text: The dog_ros launch remaps the node's private imu, joint_state and joint_cmd endpoints to /dog/imu, /dog/joint_states and /dog/gazebo_pve_controller/command.
SimulatedHardware uses a private node handle, subscribes to the relative imu and joint_state topics and advertises joint_cmd as std_msgs/Float64MultiArray.
SimulatedHardware::PublishCommand resizes the Float64MultiArray data to 60 and writes five twelve-element blocks: desired positions, kp, desired velocities, kd and feed-forward torque.
GazeboPVEController::commandCB rejects a message whose data size is not joint_cnt_ * 5 and otherwise copies the five blocks into its joint commands.
GazeboPVEController::update clamps pos_err * kp + vel_err * kd + torque for each joint to plus or minus that joint's joint_torque_limit_ entry.
GazeboPVEController::init accepts only revolute joints and fills joint_torque_limit_ from each joint's URDF effort limit.
The default controllers.yaml lists twelve actuated leg joints in the order fl_hip_x, fl_hip_y, fl_knee, fr_hip_x, fr_hip_y, fr_knee, bl_hip_x, bl_hip_y, bl_knee, br_hip_x, br_hip_y and br_knee.
motor.lua maps the same twelve joint names to motor indices zero through eleven.
SimulatedHardware::JointStateCb rejects a JointState unless its name, position, velocity and effort arrays each have twelve entries, and derives joint velocity from the position difference.
SimulatedHardware::JointStateCb finds each entry's motor index by its joint name and logs an error for an unknown name.
The libgazebo_ros_p3d.so plugin is configured with updateRate 1000.0, bodyName torso, topicName ground_truth/state and frameName world.
The dog_world launch remaps the odom_to_tf subscriber's odom name to /ground_truth/state.
The Odom2TF.py script imports nav_msgs.msg.Odometry and subscribes to its odom topic with that type.
The Gazebo IMU sensor plugin publishes on /dog/imu for the torso body at an update rate of 500 Hz.
The leg macro declares hip_x limits of -3.00 to 3.00.
The leg macro declares hip_y limits of -3.89 to 1.50.
The leg macro declares knee limits of -2.70 to 2.70.
defines.xacro sets MOTOR_TORQUE_MAX to 17 and MOTOR_VELOCITY_MAX to 40.
The motor joint macro writes MOTOR_TORQUE_MAX and MOTOR_VELOCITY_MAX as the URDF limit effort and velocity.
The dog_ros main function casts argc and argv to void and calls only test_DynamicsDiff(argc, argv).
CMakeLists.txt globs every src/*.cpp file, including the test sources, into ALL_SRCS and leaves the removal of TEST_SRCS commented out.
The package adds one dog_ros_node executable from ALL_SRCS.

determinism.notes: Event-driven rosbridge stand-in with placeholder topic samples and no physics step, controller, contact solver or wall-clock pacing

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free rosbridge contract stand-in, not a capture of Gazebo traffic: it runs no Gazebo world, ODE solver, contact model, controller update or rosbridge connection

the flat command frame is recorded only and the first desired-position field is echoed into the placeholder base x to make the arrival observable; the fake does not integrate the quadruped and cannot show that a publication was received, held or stopped
joint positions, torso pose and IMU samples are fixed placeholder values and do not advance with simulation time
the default twelve-joint configuration is served; the optional tail configuration loads fourteen joints (controllers_tail.yaml) and is NOT COVERED
the pinned repository registers no ROS stop, pause or reset service or action; a zero-valued command frame removes the PD hold and is not a safe state, so no e-stop binding is declared

the shipped dog_ros_node main calls only test_DynamicsDiff and constructs no SimulatedHardware, so the command publisher and the control loop are not part of the shipped node; a live run needs a controller process that this package does not start
no ROS graph, rosbridge connection, Gazebo simulator or hardware run has occurred

operator_required.name: publish_joint_pd_frame
operator_required.reason: the flat frame mixes rad, rad/s, N.m and two PD gains; the pinned controller clamps only the resulting torque to the URDF effort limit and states no kp or kd bound, so the deployment operator must supply the per-element envelope

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop is declared: the pinned node exposes no stop service or action, the shipped dog_ros_node runs only the test_DynamicsDiff dynamics check and publishes no command, a zero-valued joint frame only removes the PD hold, and the runtime latch therefore blocks commands without any evidence that the simulated robot stopped.
